m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Yes! It's the one from the Arcanum! I've waited my entire career for an opportunity to face one of our mortal enemies in combat!
Don't be overconfident! Arcanum members are formidable adversaries. Remember our training - there's a method to ensure victory. Use it!
Ha! So much for their methods! I say winging it is better. It's more fun too. Let's keep going.
Come to join me in savoring the Spiral's last few minutes? It's quite an occasion! The Cabal has labored toward this goal for centuries.
You helped too, with the Chronoshards and liberating Grandfather Spider. He made this possible, you know, and now, he's doing all the work!
And no need to worry. We're quite safe here. We'll be shepherded through the Spiral's annihilation and into the dawn of a new FirstWorld.
You're as sick and twisted as Grandfather Spider is, and you'll soon realize how wrong you really are.
Ah, yes. I misspoke. I said "we", but that's not entirely accurate. You will meet your doom right here and now... at my hand.
So what? You defeat me, you reactivate the portal, you enter the Sands of Time and what? You defeat Grandfather Spider? Ha! You have no hope!
That must be the way to re-open the Blast Door. Hit it and let's go!
Thank the Sands you succeeded. The portal is active and you can now enter the Sands of Time.
Even more disturbing - the Sands of Time have been reversed again. Whatever reprieve Grandmother Raven gave us was certainly short-lived.
I'm sure she did everything she could. I'm Mellori, by the way. You can think of me as the Wizard's personal assistant. I help get the job done.
I'm glad you came along. I would be of little assistance at this point. The Cabal clearly has a way of countering Chronomancer magic.
That's the portal that leads down to surface within the Sands of Time, but the Chronomaster has closed the Blast Door to block entry.
Before we can do anything else, you'll need to storm his office in the Chapter Hall and re-open the Portal Blast Door.\n
I suspect the Cabal Chronomancers will try to stop you as well as the Chronomaster himself. I'll wait here. Good luck, and be quick!
